editorial:
Imagine a world where the police are completely clueless and a criminal is the smartest person in the room. That is exactly what you get here. You follow the usual crew in Marseilles, but this time they are dealing with a slippery Belgian crook who knows how to play people. The movie has a bright, loud, and chaotic energy that makes it feel like a giant party on wheels. You will love watching the chemistry between the clumsy cop Emilien and the fast-driving taxi lead as they try to keep things under control while everything falls apart around them.

The action is fast and the car chases are the best part of the whole experience. While the plot is a bit simple and some of the jokes feel a little old, the pacing never slows down enough to make you bored. It is a perfect choice if you just want to turn your brain off and have a laugh. To get the best experience, you should try streaming it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for those crisp city views, or just rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the Belgian criminal tries to make his final escape. After a wild chase through the streets, the police finally catch up to him. The twist is that the crook's clever lies finally fail because the taxi driver's speed and skill outmatch his tricks. In the end, the bad guy is sent away to face justice, and the police celebrate another win, even if they were mostly lucky.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves goofy comedies and high-speed car chases.
